subject: Squid storm
topic: Deep below the surface, a NOAA robot was suddenly surrounded by squid.
script:
Deep below the surface, a NOAA robot was suddenly surrounded by squid.
Scientists called it a squid storm.
These are shortfin squid, and they swarmed around the robot for an entire dive.
They were hunting shrimp, fish, and maybe even each other.
Squid like these grow fast and live fast.
Most of them live for only about a year.
So they spend that short life eating almost anything they can catch.
On another dive, off Florida, the team found school after school of them.
Would you want to be the robot in the middle of this?
pkg_title: A Robot Got Caught in a SQUID STORM 🦑 #Shorts
